}}'''Navigation''' is a tier three [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Bomber]] [[unit]] and the ability to harvest [[Starfish]].  

Navigation is a crucial technology on maps that require long-distance naval bombardments.

== Polar Warfare ==
[[Polaris]] has the '''Polar Warfare''' technology instead of Navigation. Polar Warfare unlocks the [[Ice Fortress]] and the ability to harvest Starfish.

== Oceanology ==
[[Cymanti]] has the '''Oceanology''' technology instead of Navigation. Oceanology unlocks the ability to harvest starfish.

== '''Before Path of the Ocean''' ==
Before the Path of the Ocean update, Navigation unlocked the [[Battleship]] [[Units|unit]], [[movement]] on ocean tiles, and the [[Eye of God|Explorer task]].
